title: Restore named-root bind replay coverage for receipts admitted before source-text refusal
outcome: Pin the surviving named_root_bind replay-before-text-validation order after the combined gated-turn test was deleted.
acceptance: A named_root_bind-only regression installs a historical stored receipt whose workspace_id contains a Bidi_Control character and proves the exact original retry returns that stored receipt
A fresh intent containing the refused source text is still rejected; reversing replay and text refusal causes the regression to fail
